field_provenance.code: REAL - official X12 code number, verified against the published list
field_provenance.official_description: REAL - official X12 wording. Do not paraphrase and present as official.
field_provenance.plain_english: OURS - authored for clinic staff who are not billing specialists
field_provenance.trigger: OURS - the condition our rules-based labeller uses to assign this code
field_provenance.staff_action: OURS - the fix suggested to the user

meta.note: These 12 codes are the subset relevant to a Pakistani private-clinic outpatient context. The full X12 list is far larger; we scope down deliberately rather than modelling codes our synthetic data cannot express.

codes.plain_english: Pre-authorisation was required for this procedure but was not obtained.
codes.staff_action: Obtain written pre-authorisation from the insurer and attach it before submitting.

codes.official_description: The time limit for filing has expired.
codes.plain_english: This claim was submitted after the insurer's filing deadline.
codes.staff_action: Submit immediately and attach a written explanation for the delay.

codes.official_description: Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s).
codes.plain_english: Required documents or details are missing from the claim.
codes.staff_action: Complete the missing documents before submitting.

codes.official_description: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the procedure.
codes.plain_english: The diagnosis recorded does not match the procedure billed.
codes.staff_action: Re-check the diagnosis and procedure codes against the case notes.

codes.official_description: These are non-covered services because this is not deemed a 'medical necessity' by the payer.
codes.plain_english: The insurer does not consider this treatment medically necessary under this plan.
codes.trigger: elective or cosmetic procedure on a basic plan tier
codes.staff_action: Attach clinical justification, or confirm coverage with the insurer first.

codes.official_description: Non-covered charge(s). At least one Remark Code must be provided (may be comprised of either the NCPDP Reject Reason Code, or Remittance Advice Remark Code that is not an ALERT.)
codes.plain_english: This charge is not covered under the patient's plan.
codes.trigger: procedure falls outside the plan tier's coverage list
codes.staff_action: Verify plan coverage; bill the patient directly if genuinely excluded.

codes.plain_english: The patient's policy was not active on the date of treatment.
codes.staff_action: Confirm the policy status on the service date before submitting.

codes.official_description: Exact duplicate claim/service (Use only with Group Code OA except where state workers' compensation regulations requires CO).
codes.plain_english: This looks like a claim that has already been submitted.
codes.trigger: duplicate submission detected for the same patient, procedure and service date
codes.staff_action: Check the submission log before resending.

codes.official_description: Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted/legislated fee arrangement.
codes.plain_english: The amount billed is above what the insurer allows for this procedure.
codes.staff_action: Re-check the billed amount against the agreed tariff for this insurer.

codes.official_description: Claim/service not covered by this payer/contractor. You must send the claim/service to the correct payer/contractor.
codes.plain_english: This provider is outside the insurer's panel, so the claim goes to the wrong payer.
codes.staff_action: Confirm panel status with the insurer, or route the claim to the correct payer.

codes.official_description: The procedure/revenue code is inconsistent with the patient's age.
codes.plain_english: This procedure does not match the patient's age group.
codes.trigger: procedure restricted to an age band the patient is not in
codes.staff_action: Re-check the procedure code and the patient's recorded date of birth.

codes.official_description: Payment adjusted because the payer deems the information submitted does not support this many/frequency of services.
codes.plain_english: Too many claims of this type were filed for this patient in a short period.
codes.staff_action: Attach clinical justification for the repeat visits.
